content: {"reasoning":"CO-97 is a bundling denial, not an authorization or missing-information issue, and peer-to-peer review has already been attempted without resolving it. A formal appeal remains available and performed better in similar claims (2/3 paid) than peer-to-peer review (8/18 paid); another unchanged submission would not address the bundling rationale. Use the strong clinical documentation to support medical necessity and separate payment, rather than billing a patient whose contractual share is zero.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
